title: NametagToolkit
description: A few options to customize and control name tags.
body:
Client-side features work even if the mod is not installed on the server.

**Client-Side Features**

_(Configurable in a menu, the hotkey is "g" by default)_
- Toggle all nametags: On, Off, or Line of Sight (LOS)
→ With LOS enabled, nametags are hidden through walls
- Adjust the size of nametags
- Add players to an ignore list to hide their nametags individually

**Features**

- Display a player’s health next to their name
- Set a colored status in front of your name using /status
- Change your displayed name using /nickname
→ This does not affect join messages or command targeting (to prevent abuse)
- Enable incognito mode using /incognito
→ Your nametag is hidden
→ Your name appears as "???" in chat
→ You are not listed in tab
- Change your nametag color using /nametagcolor

**Operator Commands**

Operators can access more powerful versions of these commands by using the /ntt prefix.
These commands allow modifying settings for other players, while non-operator commands always apply only to yourself.
